claims.evidence: Witness report identifies it only as a red bicycle; no readable brand/model or folding mechanism details were captured.
Only general used-condition scuffing/wear is noted; no structural inspection evidence is shown.
Tire condition (tread depth, punctures, whether tires hold air) is explicitly not shown.
Brake functionality is not shown; only a headlight and general wear are visible.
No clear view of gears/speed shifters/drivetrain condition is provided in the witness observations.

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional parts (brakes, gears, reflectors/bell, wiring completeness) could make it unsafe or incomplete.
risks.proof: A full photo/video walkaround showing all components (front/rear brakes, shifters/gears, chainring/cassette, reflectors, bell, brake levers) plus a close-up of the folding joints/locks (if folding).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown working condition (worst-case: needs parts/repairs).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, punctured, or not holding air despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Close-up of tyre tread and sidewalls + a clip showing the tyres inflated and a quick spin test (and ideally a brief pump/pressure check).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres needing replacement or repair (worst-case: punctures/low tread).

risks.risk: Brakes may not be effective (pads worn, cable issues, misalignment).
risks.proof: Video clip of a safe brake test: rider/handler applies front and rear brakes while stationary and while rolling slowly; show brake lever feel and stopping power.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not guaranteed working (worst-case: service/parts needed).

risks.risk: Gears/drivetrain may skip, grind, or have chain/sprocket wear.
risks.proof: Clip showing shifting through all gears under light pedaling, plus close-ups of chain and rear cassette/freewheel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drivetrain condition unknown (worst-case: gear service needed).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/bearings may be worn causing wobble or rough rolling.
risks.proof: Video clip of wheels spun in place showing wobble + a close-up of hub/bearing area and straightness check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible bearing/wheel alignment issue (worst-case: needs truing/overhaul).

risks.risk: Structural damage or rust/cracks may exist but are not visible in the limited photo angles.
risks.proof: Photos of frame from multiple angles (including underside, head tube, seat tube, folding hinge area if any) and close-ups of any suspected cracks/rust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown structural condition (worst-case: frame may require inspection/repair).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the full bike showing: front/rear brakes, brake pads/cables, shifters, chain, rear cassette/freewheel, reflectors, and bell (if present).
Show tyre tread close-ups and confirm tyres hold air (or show recent inflation).
Provide a short video of braking test (front and rear) while rolling slowly.
Provide a short video of shifting through all gears while pedaling lightly.
Provide a wheel-spin video to check wobble and bearing smoothness.
If it is folding, show the folding hinge/lock mechanism and close-ups of the locking parts.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a red bicycle with a headlight and visible wear, but key price drivers (tyre condition, brake effectiveness, gears/drivetrain, wheel/bearing health, completeness) are not shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be too uncertain.
